description: A paragraph takes its colour from a theme token that is too light on the page background.

issue.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
issue.html: Arrives in three to five working days.
issue.failureSummary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 2.56 (foreground color: #a1a1aa, background color: #ffffff, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
